title: Carte des stations
text:
#| '!! shinylive warning !!': |
#|   shinylive does not work in self-contained HTML documents.
#|   Please set `embed-resources: false` in your metadata.
#| standalone: true
#| viewerHeight: 550

library(shiny)
library(lubridate)
library(bslib)
library(leaflet)
library(dplyr)
library(munsell)

source("fonctions.R") 

couleurs <- c("red", "darkred", "orange", "beige", "green", "darkgreen",
                     "lightgreen", "blue", "darkblue", "lightblue","purple",
                     "pink", "cadetblue", "white", "gray", "lightgray")

noms_complets_regions <- c("01: Bas-Saint-Laurent", "02: Saguenay-Lac-Saint-Jean",
      "03: Capitale-Nationale", "04: Mauricie", "05: Estrie", "06: Montréal",
      "07: Outaouais", "08: Abitibi-Témiscamingue", "09: Côte-Nord",
      "10: Nord-Du-Québec", "11: Gaspésie-Îles-de-la-Madeleine",
      "12: Chaudière-Appalaches", "13: Laval", "14: Lanaudière",
      "15: Laurentides", "16: Montérégie", "17: Centre-du-Québec")

ui <- page_fluid(
  dateRangeInput(inputId = "date", label = "Dates sélectionnées",
  start = as.Date("2015-01-01"),
  end = as.Date("2025-12-31"),
  min = as.Date("2015-01-01"),
  max = as.Date("2025-12-31"),
  format = "dd M yyyy",
  separator = " au ",
  language = "fr-CH"),
  leafletOutput("map")

)

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  
  # Données iqa
  if (!file.exists("donnees_iqa.rds")) {
    print("téléchargement données iqa")
    url <- "http://localhost:4200/data/donnees_iqa.rds"
    download.file(url, destfile = "donnees_iqa.rds", mode = "wb")
  }

  iqa <- readRDS("donnees_iqa.rds")
  
  # Mapping régions avec couleurs et noms
  regions <- sort(unique(iqa$RA))
  
  couleurs_par_region <- setNames(
    couleurs[seq_along(regions)],
    regions
  )
  
  pal_region <- colorFactor(
    palette = unname(couleurs_par_region),
    domain = as.numeric(names(couleurs_par_region))
  )
  
  noms_par_region <- setNames(
    noms_complets_regions,
    seq_along(noms_complets_regions)
  )

  # Filtrer stations et régions selon date
  iqa_stations_filtre <- reactive({ 
    iqa |>
      filter(type == "station") |>
      filter(between(date, input$date[[1]], input$date[[2]])) |>
      group_by(RA, id_station, latitude, longitude, type_milieu) |>
      summarise(
        iqa_moy_date = mean(iqa_moyen, na.rm = TRUE),
        min_iqa = min(min_iqa, na.rm = TRUE), 
        max_iqa = max(max_iqa, na.rm = TRUE), 
        prop_heure_bon = mean(prop_heure_bon, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      )
  })
  
  iqa_regions_filtre <- reactive({ 
    iqa |>
      filter(type == "region") |>
      filter(between(date, input$date[[1]], input$date[[2]])) |> 
      group_by(RA, latitude, longitude) |> 
      summarise(
        moy_regional_date = mean(iqa_moyen, na.rm = TRUE), 
        min_iqa = min(min_iqa, na.rm = TRUE), 
        max_iqa = max(max_iqa, na.rm = TRUE), 
        prop_heure_bon = mean(prop_heure_bon, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) 
  })

  output$map <- renderLeaflet({
    leaflet() |>
      addTiles() |>
      addAwesomeMarkers(
        data = iqa_stations_filtre(),
        lat = ~latitude,
        lng = ~longitude,
        popup = ~sprintf(
          paste0(
            "Latitude : %.3f<br>",
            "Longitude : %.3f<br>",
            "Proportion IQA bon : %.3f<br>",
            "Min. : %.2f<br>",
            "Max. : %.2f"
          ),
          latitude, longitude, prop_heure_bon, min_iqa, max_iqa
        ),
        label = ~sprintf(
            "région: %s, IQA moyen: %.2f", 
          noms_par_region[as.character(RA)], iqa_moy_date),
        icon = ~icone_milieu(type_milieu, RA, couleurs_par_region),
        group = "stations"
        ) |> 
      addCircleMarkers(
        data = iqa_regions_filtre(),
        lat = ~latitude, 
        lng = ~longitude, 
        color = ~unname(couleurs_par_region[as.character(RA)]),
        radius = 20,
        label = ~noms_par_region[as.character(RA)],
        popup = ~sprintf(
          paste0(
            "Latitude : %.3f<br>",
            "Longitude : %.3f<br>",
            "IQA moyen: %.3f<br>",
            "Proportion IQA bon : %.3f<br>",
            "Min. : %.2f<br>",
            "Max. : %.2f"
          ),
          latitude, longitude, moy_regional_date, prop_heure_bon, min_iqa, max_iqa
        ),
        stroke = FALSE, fillOpacity = 0.8, group = "regions"
      ) |> 
      addLegend(
        position = "topright",
        pal = pal_region,
        values = as.numeric(names(couleurs_par_region)),
        title = "Région", 
        opacity = 1
      ) |> 
      addLayersControl(
        position = "bottomleft",
        overlayGroups = c("stations", "regions"),
        options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)
      )
    })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)

## file: fonctions.R

# Pour la carte
icone_milieu <- function(milieu, RA, couleurs_par_region) {
  makeAwesomeIcon(
    icon = case_when(
      milieu == "foret" ~ "tree",
      milieu == "urbain" ~ "building",
      milieu == "agricole" ~ "glyphicon-grain",
      TRUE ~ "question"
    ),
    library = ifelse(milieu == "agricole", "glyphicon", "fa"),
    iconColor = "black",
    markerColor = unname(couleurs_par_region[as.character(RA)])
  )
}

cat_iqa <- function(x) {
  case_when (
    is.na(x) ~ NA_character_,
    round(x) <= 26 ~ "bon",
    round(x) <= 50 ~ "acceptable",
    .default = "mauvais"
      )
}
